reuse.why: Ignores the existing recurrence builder recurConfigToRSchedule (where a daily rule could drop weekend days) and adds an ad-hoc loop in getNextDate keyed on schedule.data.frequency, a field rule-utils never puts in the RSchedule data.

duplication.why: The forward and reverse 'advance past weekend occurrences' while loops are near copies of each other, and the skip/move decision is now made separately from the other getDateWithSkippedWeekend callers.

placement.why: Lives in shared/schedules.ts, the right module, but in getNextDate only rather than in the shared recurrence or weekend-rule definition used by every schedule path.

maintainability.why: Daily weekend handling now differs by code path (getNextDate skips, schedules/app getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template still move), the loops are duplicated, and the rule depends on data the schedule object does not carry.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still call getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly for daily schedules, so they never see the new skip rule placed in getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The reverse loop in getNextDate is a visible mirror of the forward loop rather than a hidden copy.

one_place.where: The skip rule is only in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts); getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and createScheduleList in server/budget/schedule-template.ts keep moving daily weekend occurrences via getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
